status: Provisional P4 simulation mass, centre of mass, inertia and propulsion parameters.
motor_position_source: Measured upper/lower motor origins mirrored across body X/Y.
caveats: Total 3 kg includes all eight VMGs and six sensors; base link contains the remaining mass.
Base CoM, equivalent-box inertia and motor thrust/torque/spool are provisional.
Conventional balanced X8 spins; not a measurement of real ESC output order.
Motor housings are fixed to base_link; propeller meshes rotate on the thrust-producing rotor joints. The visual slowdown factor does not change the configured thrust law.
No coaxial interference, calibrated drag, power/battery model, or true Velox/T9048 characterization.
PX4 IMU sits at the body datum; external payload measurements are not injected into its EKF.
